picture-pairs.name: Piyryn jalloo
picture-pairs.description: Cluaine cumadh-sheeaght, bane as shaghey, son inshey as sthie-yn-er-yn-aer. Ta'n cairtyn fo-ghoaill ayns chaghlaa as fyllee. Cha vel chloie na sooyl ec yn cluaine.
picture-pairs.short: Fow y daa yalloo ta gollrish y cheilley. Foddee ny jallooyn tannaghtyn ry-akin.
picture-pairs.intro: Broo er jalloo, as eisht broo er y fer ta gollrish. Ta ny jallooyn tannaghtyn ry-akin dy cadjin, myr shen cha nel feme erbee ayn dy chooinaghtyn nhee erbee. Tra ta daa yalloo goll ry-cheilley, t'ad geddyn oirr airh as cowrey kiart.
howTo: Reih cre whilleen leac lhisagh y ve ayn. Ta kiare leacyn nyn ynnyd kiune dy hoshee.
Broo er jalloo erbee. T'eh geddyn oirr airh.
Broo er y jalloo ta gollrish. Ta'n piyr tannaghtyn ry-cheilley marish cowrey kiart.
My ta'n daa yalloo anchasley, cha nel nhee erbee olk taghyrt. Broo reesht tra ta shiu aarloo.
Lhig da "Jallooyn follit" ve er tra ta shiu nyn ndeees carrey lesh y chummey cadjin er nyn oaieyn sheese.
tips: Enmys-jee ny jallooyn magh dy ard ry-cheilley as coloayrt my nyn gione: "Cappan tey jiarg. Vel shiu goaill bainney ayns nyn dey?"
Lhig da'n peiagh ta shiu cur kiarail da broo er ny jallooyn, eer my t'eh goaill tammylt. Pointeil ayns ynnyd jeh broo er nyn son.
Tannee marish kiare leacyn choud's t'eh maynrey. She reih t'ayn dy ghoaill tooilley leacyn, cha nel eh rieau ny cheim dy roshtyn.
Cur jerrey er choud's t'eh foast taitnyssagh. Ta un ghamman ny ymmyrch slane hene.

faq.q: Vel oorydderey ny skoor ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skoor, earrooder scughey ny cailjyn ayn. Foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee, as ta scuirr lieh-vollagh ny aght feer vie dy chur jerrey er.

faq.q: Cre'n fa ta ny jallooyn tannaghtyn er nyn oaieyn seose?
faq.a: Lesh freayll ny jallooyn ry-akin, ta'n gamman bentyn rish jeeaghyn as co-reggyrt ayns ynnyd jeh cooinaghtyn. S'kiuney lesh ram sleih eh shoh. Foddee shiu caghlaa dys jallooyn follit lesh un vroo my sailliu.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er recortys?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, recortys ny laadey neose ry-laccal. T'eh obbraghey ayns y vrowser eddyr-vwaill er chellvane, claare-screeuee ny co-earrooder.

faq.q: Vod mayd jannoo ymmyd jeh caslyssyn-shoilshey y lught-thie ain hene?
faq.a: Foddee. Jean prowaltys lesh Photo pairs, ta lhiggey diu reih caslyssyn-shoilshey voish y ghreie eu. Ta ny caslyssyn-shoilshey tannaghtyn ayns y vrowser eu as cha nel ad goll er laadey seose.

find-the-same.name: Fow y fer cheddin
find-the-same.seoTitle: Faggyr yn Chairt Cheddin: Cluaine Sumar Shoh
find-the-same.description: Unnane ayns jeh'n mullagh, daa dy ceathar ayns jeh'n eayst. Crooy yn un ta kiart. Cluaine sheeaght, mychione er-yn-aer, son inshey as cooishyn, cha vel chloie ayn.
find-the-same.short: Jeeagh er y jalloo ec y vullagh as broo er y fer cheddin heese.
find-the-same.intro: Ta un yalloo ny hoie ec mullagh y scaailan. Fo, ta daa, tree ny kiare jallooyn. Broo er y fer ta gollrish. She un reih aashagh ec un traa t'ayn, marish ram traa dy choloayrt.
howTo: Reih daa, tree ny kiare jallooyn dy reih voue. She daa y fer s'aashagh.
Jeeagh-jee er y jalloo ec y vullagh ry-cheilley.
Broo er y jalloo cheddin heese. T'eh er ny chowraghey lesh cowrey kiart as kuse dy ocklyn caarjoil.
My vees brooit er jalloo elley, cha nel y gamman agh cur ennym er as fuirraghtyn. Gow-jee nyn draa.
Broo er "Y nah yalloo" tra ta shiu aarloo son fer elley.
tips: Coloayrt-jee mychione dagh jalloo roish reih: daaghyn, cummaghyn, raad dy vodbar fakin eh.
Cha nel daa reih "ro aashagh". She taitnys y dean, cha nel doilleeid.
My ta broo doillee, foddee y peiagh pointeil as foddee shiuish broo er nyn son.

faq.q: Vel oorydderey ny skoor ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skoor, earrooder scughey ny cailjyn ayn. Foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee, as ta scuirr lieh-vollagh ny aght feer vie dy chur jerrey er.

faq.q: Cre ta taghyrt my vees brooit er y jalloo neuchiart?
faq.a: Cha nel nhee erbee neuhaitnyssagh taghyrt. Cha nel tharmane, crosh yiarg ny craa ayn. Ta'n gamman cur ennym er y jalloo va brooit as fuirraghtyn rish y nah vroo.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er recortys?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, recortys ny laadey neose ry-laccal. T'eh obbraghey ayns y vrowser eddyr-vwaill er chellvane, claare-screeuee ny co-earrooder.

shadow-match.name: Co-reggyrt scaadoo
shadow-match.seoTitle: Cluaine Cur-Shoh Sheeaght: Saor Ayns Line
shadow-match.description: Shadow dorraghey ayns jeh'n mullagh, daa dy ceathar dy chairtyn ayns jeh'n eayst. Crooy yn chairt ta cur yn shadow. Cluaine sheeaght, saor, cur-shoh gyn chloie.
shadow-match.short: Jeeagh er y scaadoo as broo er y jalloo ta jannoo eh.
shadow-match.intro: Ta co-reggyrt scaadoo ny obbyr chadjin voish duillagyn obbyr clouit, agh ayns shoh marish jallooyn mooarey as veg dy chlou. Ta scaadoo bog ny hoie ec mullagh y scaailan as daa, tree ny kiare jallooyn fuirraghtyn heese. Broo er y fer ta jannoo y scaadoo. T'eh aashagh dy choloayrt mychione cummaghyn myr roar, scaath-fliaghee ny cappan tey chammah.
howTo: Reih daa, tree ny kiare jallooyn dy reih voue. She daa y fer s'aashagh.
Jeeagh-jee er y scaadoo ry-cheilley. Cre'n cummey t'er? Vel eh ard ny cruinn?
Broo er y jalloo ta jannoo y scaadoo. Ta'n ennym echey ry-akin fo'n scaadoo.
My vees brooit er jalloo elley, cha nel y gamman agh cur ennym er as fuirraghtyn. Gow-jee nyn draa.
Broo er "Y nah scaadoo" tra ta shiu aarloo son fer elley.
tips: Lhiant-jee rish oirr y scaadoo lesh mair as coloayrt-jee mychione y chummey.
My ta ny scaadooghyn doillee jiu, caghlaa dys Fow y fer cheddin, raad ta ny jallooyn cosoylagh.
Coloayrt-jee mychione y jalloo lurg da v'er ny feddyn: "Va scaath-fliaghee gollrish shen ain hene."

faq.q: Vel oorydderey ny skoor ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skoor, earrooder scughey ny cailjyn ayn. Foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee, as ta scuirr lieh-vollagh ny aght feer vie dy chur jerrey er.

faq.q: Vel daoine ta cur shoh cheet mychione ny cosh t'ayd cur-shoh fo-ghoaill?
faq.a: Ta mayn daoine fo-ghoaill ny, as ta cuid jeh daoine ta cur shoh cheet mychione ny cosh t'ayd, nagh vel fo-ghoaill ny, er yn oor ny share ny stoo. Ta cumaghyn sassoo yn ny focklyn. Ta eh son fo-ghoaill as cooney, cha vel prowal eh, as cha vel eh sheeaghey ny lheihsey dementia. My vel eh cur feeyl dy aalin, fell y Faggyr yn Chairt Cheddin ny jean er-yn-aer chairtyn ry-hoi.

faq.q: Cre ta taghyrt my vees crig er y drogh yalloo?
faq.a: Veg neuhaitnyssagh. Cha nel sheeaner, crosh ruy ny craa erbee ayn. Ta'n cloie cur ennym er y jalloo va criggit er as fuirraghtyn rish y nah chrig.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er fo-screeu?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, fo-screeu ny laadey neose erbee ayn. T'eh gobbraghey ayns y jeeagheyder-moghey er çhellvane, claare-screeuee ny co-earrooder.

four-together.name: Ceathar ry-henn
four-together.seoTitle: Cluaine Rheynn Chairtyn son Daoine Aasit: Ceathar Ry-henn
four-together.h1: Ceathar Ry-henn: Cluaine Rheynn Chairtyn Sheeaght
four-together.description: Ta cuid jeh'n chairtyn cur-rheynn er y chooish, ny-yiarn bunnane ny aer. Crooy ny ta goll ry-henn. Cluaine rheynn sheeaght, gyn chloie as gyn cur-shoh.
four-together.short: Faggyr yn chairtyn ta goll ry-henn, myr bunnane ny aer.
four-together.intro: Ayns ny chairtyn beg, ta cuid jeh'n chairtyn goll ry-henn: ceathar sorts bunnane, ny ceathar dy hoiltyn dy ymmyrkey. Crooy ny ta cur-rheynn er y chooish cheddin. My vel chairt goll rish cooish elley, ta'n cluaine ny-yiarn eh as jean eh fannoo. Er-dy-hoal goll dy dyn shean, ta fockle ayns ny cooish ta cur-rheynn ny share, as ta "Sheeagh yn rheynn" ayns ny oor shen ny lhiassaghey.
howTo: Crooy ceathar, shey ny ayr chairtyn. Ceathar yn sample sheeaght, cur-rheynn jeh tree ta goll ry-henn.
Jean sthie-yn-chairtyn ry-hoi as ny cur-coraghey mychione ny ta goll ayns ad.
Crooy yn chairt jeh gheddyn yn rheynn. Vel bordyr offordagh as marrey er.
My vel chairt goll rish cooish elley, ta'n cluaine ny-yiarn eh as jean eh fannoo. Gow dy eaghtyn.
Crooy "Sheeagh yn rheynn" da oor ny lhiassaghey, as "Rheynn elley" son chairtyn noa.
tips: Abbyr ny ta shin feer'ys dy ghoaill: "Ta'n daa shen ny biwoyn bunnane."
Cha vel bree ayns shen. Ta fockle ayns ny cooish ta cur-rheynn er y chooish ny lhiassaghey, as ta shin meanagh dy fakin er.
Cur-coraghey mychione'n rheynn gys currit eh: bunnane fo-ghoaill, turrys ry-hoi, aer jiu.

faq.q: Vel chloie ny sooyl ayn?
faq.a: Cha vel. Cha vel clock, sooyl, cooid jeh ymmyr ny cur-lhiassaghey ayn. Vel oo fo dy hoi er unrish oor, as ta cur-meanagh ry-hoi ny ta fo-ghoaill ayns cheim er-yn-aer.

faq.q: Cre vel currit my vel chairt jeh sthie-yn-rheynn crooit?
faq.a: Cha vel cooish drogh currit. Cha vel buzzer, cross dearg ny shaghey ayn. Ta'n cluaine ainm yn chairt, goll dy ta eh rish cooish elley, as sthie gys yn chrooy ry-heet.

faq.q: Ta'n rheynnyn er-ny-hene?
faq.a: Cooishyn ta lhiassagh jeh ry-chooilley ta cha nheeaghyn er-ny-hene: bunnane, biwoyn, booagh, aer, dooghyn dy goll, cooishyn son dyl teeas as cooishyn ta bakit ayns oonyn. Ta chairt jiu ry-hoi ayns un rheynn ynrick.

faq.q: Vel eh saor, as nee shin cur-ainm ny cur-cloie?
faq.a: Ta, vel eh saor, as cha vel cuntas, cur-ainm ny loayrt ec ayn. Vel eh geearree ayns y browsyr lioar ry-hoi ayns fone, tablet ny computer.

odd-one-out.name: Yn chairt neayrey
odd-one-out.seoTitle: Cluaine Chairtyn Neayrey son Daoine Aasit
odd-one-out.h1: Yn Chairt Neayrey: Cluaine Sheeaght Cairtyn
odd-one-out.description: Tree ny ceathar chairtyn, as ta ny cuid oc goll ry-henn er y chooish, myr bunnane ny aer. Crooy yn un nagh vel goll ayns shen. Saor, sheeaght, gyn chloie as gyn sooyl.
odd-one-out.short: Faggyr yn chairt nagh vel goll rish ny elley.
odd-one-out.intro: Tree ny ceathar chairtyn, as ta ny cuid oc goll ry-henn: bunnane, my vel, ny dooghyn dy goll. Crooy yn chairt nagh vel goll ayns shen. My vel chairt goll rish ny elley, ta'n cluaine enmyn shen ny jeh'n cheayrt as sthie. Er-dy-hoal goll dy dyn shean, ta fockle ayns ny cooish ta ny elley coamagh, as ta "Sheeagh ym" ayns ny oor shen son dy lhiassaghey yn un neayrey.
howTo: Crooy tree ny ceathar chairtyn. Tree yn sample sheeaght.
Jean sthie-yn-chairtyn ry-hoi as ny cur-coraghey mychione ny ta lheid dy ny ta ayns ad ry-chooilley.
Crooy yn chairt nagh vel goll ayns shen. Vel bordyr offordagh as marrey er.
My vel chairt goll rish ny elley, ta'n cluaine enmyn shen as sthie. Gow dy eaghtyn.
Crooy "Sheeagh ym" da oor ny lhiassaghey, as "Rheynn elley" son chairtyn noa.
tips: Cur-coraghey eh ayns kiare: "Ta'n ubbyl as yn ooyl daa bunnane. Cre mychione yn bus?"
Cha vel bree ayns shen. Ta fockle ayns ny cooish ta cur-rheynn er y chooish ny lhiassaghey, as ta shin meanagh dy fakin er.
Vel coraghey ry-chooilley chairt toshiaght mie son cur-coraghey: bunnane fo-ghoaill, sheidey bus, laa ny ushtey.

faq.q: Vel chloie ny sooyl ayn?
faq.a: Cha vel. Cha vel clock, sooyl, cooid jeh ymmyr ny cur-lhiassaghey ayn. Vel oo fo dy hoi er unrish oor, as ta cur-meanagh ry-hoi ny ta fo-ghoaill ayns cheim er-yn-aer.

faq.q: Cre vel currit my vel chairt ta goll ry-henn crooit?
faq.a: Cha vel cooish drogh currit. Cha vel buzzer, cross dearg ny shaghey ayn. Ta'n cluaine ainm yn chairt, goll dy ta eh rish ny elley, as sthie gys yn chrooy ry-heet.

faq.q: Vod ta'n chairt neayrey currit er-son?
faq.a: Ta'n chairtyn jeh cooishyn lhiassagh jeh ry-chooilley nagh vel feum da shassoo sheeaght: bunnane, biwoyn, booagh, aer, dooghyn dy goll, cooishyn son dyl teeas as cooishyn ta bakit ayns oonyn. Ta chairt jiu ry-hoi ayns un chooish ynrick, as ta'n chairt neayrey jeh chooish elley ersooyl.

faq.q: Ta eh saor, as vel mee dy chur ayns cunntas?
faq.a: Ta, ta eh saor, as cha vel cunntas, clare ny download. Obbyr eh ayns brouser-lioh er fon, tablet ny computer.

color-match.name: Freayll dath
color-match.h1: Freayll Dath: Cur geddyn dealbhyn un dath
color-match.description: Dath mooar lesh e ennym, as ceithear ny shey dealbhyn. Bog er gach dealbh ta dy dath shen. Cha vel cloc, cha vel scoir, as ta dath elley er ny hinnsey ny sleih. Saor dy chluich as dy phrint.
color-match.short: Faadoo gach dealbh ta dy dath cheddin ny ta dy hoie er y dath ta er ny thaishbeen.
color-match.players: 1 ny 2 dooinney, ny dooinney as paitchey
color-match.intro: Ta bleeant mooar dath er ny thaishbeen, as ta ennym er screeu ry-hoi. Foast ta ceithear ny shey dealbhyn. Bog er gach dealbh ta dy dath shen: ubbyl ruy as cupp ruy, dy sampyl. Mannagh vel dealbh dy dath elley, ta'n geam goaill ennym er ("Ta'n peer glass.") as feddyn fanish. "Taishbee dhymmyn" ta dy ghoaill dealbhyn cheddin ry-hoi, as "Dath elley" ta dy chur dagh dath.
howTo: Tagh ceithear ny shey dealbhyn. Ceithear ta yn ny sauail.
Sow er y dath as lioor er e ennym ayns cooishyn.
Bog er gach dealbh ta dy dath shen. Vel crial mooar as markey er ny dealbhyn shen.
Mannagh vel dealbh dy dath elley, ta'n geam hoilshey cre'n dath eh as ta fanish. Gow dy hoiliu.
Bog "Taishbee dhymmyn" tra t'ou toiylt, as eisht "Dath elley" son dath noa.
tips: Abair y dath ayns guee, as eisht sheeaghey mychione: cre elley ta dy dath shen?
Cur dty gherrynyn dhyts mannagh vel dhyt toiylt: "tomate" ny "niaul" ta mie dy liooar as "ruy" ny "gorm".
Taishbeynys ta mie dy liooar cha nee bogh. Soie ry-hoi as shiu nyn daa dy chur shilley er y screen.

faq.q: Vel cloc ny scoir?
faq.a: Cha vel. Cha vel cloc, scoir, cunnaght dy ghoail ny cailleil. Gow dy stoo dy hoiggal ec unrych ynnyd, as stoo ayns y chliaght vel ny fer mie dy hoiggal.

faq.q: Cre hannah mannagh vel dealbh dy dath elley bogh er?
faq.a: Cha vel shen olk. Cha vel buzzer, crosh ruy na jeeaghyn. Ta'n geam goaill ennym er y dealbh as e dath, dy sampyl "Ta'n peer glass.", as feddyn fanish er y bog nesh.

faq.q: Vel dath y chooish eh ynrick?
faq.a: Cha vel. Ta'n dath taishbeenit ayns bleeant mooar as screeuit ayns focley, as ta gach dealbh goit ennym tra vees bogh er. Gow ny ta cheilley cadjin dath cur ayns lhiastey lesh y ennym dooghyn.

faq.q: Ta dealbh yn dath jeh?
faq.a: Ta'n dealbhyn currit lhiam ry-hoi, as ny dealbhyn ta'n cooish mooar plain dy dath unnane. Ta dealbhyn lesh daa dath ny tree, dy sampyl feeu ny bee, fagit magh.

faq.q: Vel dealbh ayns paiper?
faq.a: Ta. Ta paiper aon-dhuillag ec ceithear reamyn. Ta dagh ream goit ennym dath as taishbeys ceithear dealbhyn dy taishbeynys ny cur cruinnagh er.

faq.q: Ta eh saor, as vel mee dy chur ayns cunntas?
faq.a: Ta, ta eh saor, as cha vel cunntas, clare ny download. Obbyr eh ayns brouser-lioh er fon, tablet ny computer.

halves-match.name: Leth-freayll
halves-match.h1: Leth-freayll: Cur daa leth dealbh ry-chur
halves-match.description: Leth-chliaghyn dy daa ny tree dealbhyn ayns bleeant jiu, as lethyn yn ghiaraght ayns elley. Bog er leth, as eisht y leth ta cur ry-cheaghey. Cha vel cloc, cha vel scoir, as lethyn nagh vel cur ry-cheaghey ta jeeaghyn ry-hoi dy chooilleeney. Saor dy chluich as dy phrint.
halves-match.short: Bog er y daa leth ta cur ry-cheaghey dy hoi dy chur dealbh ayns.
halves-match.players: 1 ny 2 dooinney, ny dooinney as paitchey
halves-match.intro: Ta dagh dealbh goit ec y meeacan. Ta leth-chliaghyn dy daa ny tree dealbhyn ayns colley, as lethyn yn ghiaraght, ayns oardey elley, ayns y ghoan elley. Bog er leth er y cheer clea, eisht bog er y leth er y ghiaraght ta cur ry-cheaghey lesh, dy sampyl sumyr kettle as e craue. Lethyn ta cur ry-cheaghey ta cheilleit ayns dealbh slane. Lethyn nagh vel cur ry-cheaghey ta gobbragh magh arrey as ta'n geam gra shen gee. "Taishbee dhymmyn" ta goail ad uile ry-cheilley.
howTo: Tagh daa ny tree dealbhyn. Daa ta yn ny sauail.
Sow er y leth-chliaghyn cheddin. Cre ta shen dy vow pairt jeh?
Bog er leth er y cheer clea, eisht bog er y leth er y ghiaraght ta cur ry-cheaghey. Ta'n obbyr shen jeh'n taobh elley cadjin.
Ta lethyn cur ry-cheaghey cheilleit lesh crial mooar as markey. Ta lethyn nagh vel cur ry-cheaghey goit magh arrey, as vees oo gow arrane.
Bog "Taishbee dhymmyn" tra t'ou toiylt, eisht "Set elley" son dealbhyn noa.
tips: Lhiggey lhiam ny meer er chliaght leth. Cre ard ta'n drawing goll gys y meeacan?
Abair cre ta t'ou gra: "Ta craue er shen." Cha vel feme dy ennym dy chooilleeney dealbh.
Taishbeynys ta mie dy liooar cha nee bogh. Soie ry-hoi as shiu nyn daa dy chur shilley er y screen.

faq.q: Vel cloc ny scoir?
faq.a: Cha vel. Cha vel cloc, scoir, cunnaght dy ghoail ny cailleil. Gow dy stoo dy hoiggal ec unrych ynnyd, as stoo ayns y chliaght vel ny fer mie dy hoiggal.

faq.q: Cre hannah mannagh vel daa leth cur ry-cheaghey?
faq.a: Cha vel shen olk. Cha vel buzzer, crosh ruy na jeeaghyn. Ta'n daa leth goit magh arrey as ta'n geam gra: "Cha vel y daa shen cur ry-cheaghey. Feddyn elley." Cha vel shen currit.

faq.q: Vel dealbhyn ayns y chooilleeney ny ayns lhiastey?
faq.a: Ta. Ta dealbhyn currit lhiam ry-hoi, as cha vel daa dealbh ayns bord shen jeh'n ghrupp cheddin, dy sampyl daa vraue ny daa eeanlee. Cha vel dealbhyn nagh vel lethyn dy oik cheddin ayns ny daa leth, dy sampyl y greiney ny y rainbow, fagit magh.

faq.q: Vel dealbh ayns paiper?
faq.a: Gu h-ea. Ta duilleag bheag ag cur leth-chlé nan trì dealbhan ann an aon cholbh, agus an leth-dheas aca ann an òrdugh eile sa cholbh eile. Tarraing loidhne o gach leth-chlé gu an leth a fhreagras air.

faq.q: A bheil e saor, agus feum mi clàradh?
faq.a: Tha, tha e saor, agus chan eil cunntas, clàradh no luchdachadh a-nuas ann. Bidh e ag obair anns a' bhrabhsair-lìn air fòn, tablaid no coimpiutair.

color-by-number.name: Dath a rèir àireamh
color-by-number.seoTitle: Dath a rèir Àireamh: Geama Lìonaidh Socair le Clò Mòr
color-by-number.h1: Dath a rèir Àireamh: Lìon na ceàrnagan, dath sam bith a thaghas tu
color-by-number.description: Greid de cheàrnagan mòra le àireamhan agus iuchair de cheithir dathan leis na h-ainmean aca. Tagh dath, an uair sin thoir briogadh air ceàrnagan gus an lìonadh. Tha dath sam bith ceart, chan eil tomhaiche no sgòr ann, agus bidh putan a' lìonadh na làithean a tha air fhàgail a rèir nan àireamhan. Saor ri cluich agus ri clò-bhualadh.
color-by-number.short: Tagh dath, an uair sin thoir briogadh air na ceàrnagan le àireamhan gus an lìonadh.
color-by-number.intro: Greid chearnagach de cheàrnagan mòra, le àireamh air gach fear, agus iuchair os a cionn le ceithir dathan, gach fear leis an àireamh agus an t-ainm sgrìobhte aige. Tagh dath on iuchair, an uair sin thoir briogadh air ceàrnagan gus an lìonadh. Tha an greid 4 air 4 aig an toiseach, agus 6 air 6 agus 8 air 8 nuair a tha thu ag iarraidh barrachd cheàrnagan. Nuair a tha dath na h-àireamh air a h-uile ceàrnag, is e an greid an dealbh air an duilleig. Tha ceàrnagan a tha air an lìonadh le dath sam bith eile dìreach mar dhealbh agad fhèin, agus cha bhi an geama ag ràdh dad mu dheidhinn. Tha "Lìon a rèir nan àireamhan" a' lìonadh a h-uile ceàrnag falamh dhut.
howTo: Tagh meud na greide. Tha na ceàrnagan as motha aig 4 air 4 agus is e an fheadhainn as sìmplidh a th' ann.
Thoir sùil air an iuchair os cionn na greide. Tha àireamh agus ainm aig gach dath, mar 1 Buidhe.
Thoir briogadh air dath san iuchair, an uair sin thoir briogadh air na ceàrnagan a bu toigh leat a lìonadh leis.
Cleachd an dath a tha air an àireamh, no dath sam bith a thaghas tu. Tha an dà rud ceart.
Thoir briogadh air "Lìon a rèir nan àireamhan" airson na ceàrnagan falamh, "Glan" gus an greid a thòiseachadh a-rithist, no "Dealbh eile" airson fear eile.
tips: Suidh taobh ri taobh agus gabh do thuras: tagh aon duine an dath, agus thoir an fheadhainn eile briogadh air a' cheàrnag.
Bruidhinn mu na dathan: "Is toigh leam an uaine." Chan fheum thu ainmeachadh dè a bhios san dealbh.
Air sgrìn chumhang bidh an greid 8 air 8 a' sgrolladh gu taobh a-staigh a bhogsa fhèin. Fanaidh na ceàrnagan aig meud comhfhurtail.
Obraichidh an dreach pàipeir cuideachd le peansailean aig bòrd ri taobh leabaidh.

faq.q: A bheil tomhaiche ùine no sgòr ann?
faq.a: Chan eil. Chan eil cloc, sgòr, cunntair ghluasadan no call ann. Faodaidh tu stad aig àm sam bith, agus tha stad air meadhan an rud gu math ceart airson crìoch a chur air.

faq.q: Dè thachras ma chleachdas mi dath eadar-dhealaichte bhon àireamh?
faq.a: Cha tachair dad, agus sin an rud. Faodar dath sam bith a chur ann an ceàrnag sam bith, agus cha bhi an geama ag ràdh dad mu dheidhinn. Nuair a tha dath na h-àireamh air a h-uile ceàrnag, bidh an geama ag innse sin gu socair, agus tha dealbh ann an dathan do fhèin cho math ris.

faq.q: An urrainn daoine le dall-dhathan na dathan a dh'aithneachadh bho chèile?
faq.a: Chaidh an taghadh gus sin a dhèanamh. Tha àireamh, ainm sgrìobhte agus cruth beag aige fhèin air gach dath, mar sin chan e an dath a-mhàin an dòigh air an aithneachadh. Chaidh na ceithir lìonaidhean a sgrùdadh le samhlaidhean de dhall-dhathan dearg-uaine agus gorm-buidhe, agus tha iad eadar-dhealaichte cuideachd ann an soilleireachd. Chan eil neach le dall-dhathan air feuchainn orra fhathast, mar sin innis dhuinn ma tha dà cheann a' coimhead coltach ri chèile.

faq.q: A bheil na ceàrnagan mòr gu leòr airson crathadh no sgrìn bheag?
faq.a: Tha a h-uile ceàrnag co-dhiù 48 piogsail a leud, agus 56 air a' ghreid 4 air 4. Ma tha greid ro leathan airson na sgrìn, bidh i a' sgrolladh gu taobh a-staigh a bogsa fhèin an àite na ceàrnagan a dhùmhlachadh.

faq.q: A bheil dreach pàipeir ann?
faq.a: Tha. Tha duilleag bheag le greid àireamhaichte agus iuchair nan ceithir dathan leis na h-ainmean aca. Dath gach ceàrnag le peansail den dath air an àireamh, no dath sam bith a thaghas tu.

faq.q: A bheil e saor, agus feum mi clàradh?
faq.a: Tha, tha e saor, agus chan eil cunntas, clàradh no luchdachadh a-nuas ann. Bidh e ag obair anns a' bhrabhsair-lìn air fòn, tablaid no coimpiutair.

pattern-maker.name: Dèanamair phàtrain
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Dèanamair Phàtrain: Dealbhaich tile agus clò-bhuail am pàtran
pattern-maker.h1: Dèanamair Phàtrain: Dealbhaich tile, faic e a' ath-aithris
pattern-maker.description: Atharraich ceàrnagan tile bheag agus faic e a' ath-aithris na phàtran ri thaobh, ann an ceithir dathan aig a bheil ainm agus cruth. Chan eil tomhaiche no sgòr ann. Saor ri cluich agus ri clò-bhualadh.
pattern-maker.short: Atharraich ceàrnagan tile bheag agus faic e a' ath-aithris na phàtran.
pattern-maker.intro: Tile bheag de 3 air 3 cheàrnagan, no 4 air 4 ma tha thu ag iarraidh, agus ri a thaobh "do phàtran": an aon tile air ath-aithris ann am bloc. Thoir briogadh air ceàrnag agus atharraichidh i gu an ath dhath de cheithir, gach fear leis an ainm sgrìobhte agus an cruth aige fhèin. Atharraichidh am pàtran ri thaobh sa bhad. Chan eil pàtran ceart ann, agus chan eil dad air a shàbhaladh no air a chur. Tha "Clò-bhuail am pàtran agam" a' cur a' phàtrain ath-aithrisich air duilleig aon-taobh gus a ghleidheadh, a dhathadh no a thoirt do dhuine eile.
howTo: Thoir sùil air an tile agus air do phàtran ri thaobh. Is e an aon tile a tha iad, air ath-aithris.
Thoir briogadh air ceàrnag. Atharraichidh i gu an dath as làidire san t-sreath de cheithir dathan os a cionn.
Lean ort a' briogadh air ceàrnagan gus an coimhead am pàtran mar a tha thu ag iarraidh. Is e pàtran math sam bith a th' ann.
Thoir briogadh air "Iongnadh orm" airson tile ùr, no "Tòisich a-rithist" airson tile glan. Tillidh "Cuir air ais e" an tile a bh' agad.
Thoir briogadh air "Clò-bhuail am pàtran agam" ma tha thu ag iarraidh air pàipear, no thoir briogadh air Fois gus stad.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Talk about what you see: "That looks like a flower." There is no need to name anything.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything I make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. Your tile stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep a pattern, print it.

faq.q: What if I tap the wrong square or clear the tile by accident?
faq.a: There is no wrong square: tap it again to move on to the next color. After "Start again" or "Surprise me", "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each square, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the squares big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every square is at least 56 pixels across. If the tile is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print my pattern" prints the pattern you made on one page, with the four colors and their names, fine in black and white because every color has its own shape.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

drawing-duet.name: Drawing duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Picture
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Sheet
drawing-duet.description: Two people take turns drawing lines on one shared canvas, each in a color of their own. Nobody scores or wins, and the picture can be saved or printed. Free to play, with no account.
drawing-duet.short: Take turns drawing one shared picture with someone beside you.
drawing-duet.intro: One canvas, two people. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name. You take turns: draw one line or shape, then pass the pen. Either of you may pass at any time. There is no right picture and no score. Save the picture to your device if you like it, or print the paper version: one sheet, two pens.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. The banner says whose turn it is, with that person's color by name.
Draw one line or shape with a finger, a mouse or a pen. Or use the arrow keys and Space to draw without a pointer.
When you are ready, tap "Pass the pen". Either of you may pass at any time.
Tap "Take back my last line" to remove the newest line of the person whose turn it is.
Tap "Save picture" to make a picture file on this device, or "Print the paper version" for one sheet and two pens.
tips: Sit side by side and talk as you draw: "I will add a sun in the corner."
Start with a dot, a line or a simple shape, and let the other person answer it.
Nobody has to draw a picture of anything. A pattern of lines is just as good as a scene.
If you want to stop, tap "Done for now". Your picture is not kept after you leave the page unless you save it.

faq.q: Is there a winner or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, no score, no timer and no count of turns. There is no right picture, and nothing is ranked or compared.

faq.q: Is the picture saved or sent?
faq.a: No, nothing is sent anywhere. The picture stays on this page until you close it. If you tap Save picture, a file is made on your device for you to download. Nothing is uploaded.

faq.q: Can I take back a line?
faq.a: Yes. "Take back my last line" removes the newest line of the person whose turn it is. "Start again" clears the sheet, and "Put it back" brings the lines back, one step only.

faq.q: Can I use this without a mouse or touch screen?
faq.a: Yes. When the drawing has focus, the arrow keys move a pen dot, and the Space key puts the pen down or up. The screen says "Pen down" or "Pen up" each time.

faq.q: What colors are they, and can people with color-blindness tell them apart?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green and purple, the same four colors used in our other picture games. Each has a written name, and the names show beside the turn. The colors were checked with simulations of common color-vision differences, but a person with color-vision differences has not yet tried them.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the paper version" prints one sheet with the rules on it and a large blank frame to draw in, for two people with two pens. It works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Ta shen, saor in aer, agus cha bi cunntas no clàr-clàraidh no luchdachadh a-sìos ann. Obraichidh e anns a' bhrabhsair-lìn air fòn, tablaid no coimpiutair.

build-together.name: Build together
build-together.seoTitle: Build Together: Two People Build One Pattern
build-together.h1: Build Together: Two People, One Grid
build-together.description: Two people take turns to put a piece in a shared grid until it is full, each with a color of their own that has a name and a shape. Nobody wins, and there is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
build-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to fill one shared grid.
build-together.intro: A shared grid of 4 by 4 places, or 3 by 3 if you like. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name and shape. You take turns: on your turn, tap an empty place to put your piece there. When every place has a piece, the picture is built together. There is no winner, because you make it as a pair, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print the grid" puts an empty grid on one page so you can build with two pencils.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. A color the other person has is marked "In use".
The first person goes first. The screen says whose turn it is and which color is theirs.
Tap an empty place to put your piece there. The turn passes to the other person.
If you would rather not place a piece, tap "Pass". Either of you may pass at any time.
When every place has a piece, you have built the picture together. Tap "Start again" to build another, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Sit side by side so you can both see and reach the screen. Talk as you go: "I will put mine next to yours."
Try to build a pattern, stripes, a checkerboard or a border, or just place pieces anywhere you like. Both are fine.
A child or a person who tires easily can pass as often as they like. The picture is still built together.
On paper, each person uses one pencil and draws their own shape in the empty squares.

faq.q: Is there a winner, a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, because you build one picture together. There is no clock, score, count of pieces or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything we make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The grid stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep it, print the grid and build on paper.

faq.q: What if I put a piece in the wrong place?
faq.a: There is no wrong place. Tap "Take back the last piece" and the turn goes back to you. You can take back one step at a time, and a pass can be taken back too.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each piece, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the places big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every place is at least 56 pixels across. If the grid is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the places.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the grid" prints an empty grid on one page with the two colors and their names, to build with two pencils. It works in black and white because every color has its own shape.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seated-toss.name: Seated toss tally
seated-toss.seoTitle: Seated Toss Tally: a Bean-Bag Game for Two
seated-toss.h1: Seated Toss Tally: Toss Together at a Table
seated-toss.description: Two people at a table take turns tossing a soft bean bag into a big target and keep the tally on paper. Nothing is timed or scored. Free to print.
seated-toss.short: Take turns tossing a bean bag at a big target, with the tally on paper.
seated-toss.intro: A calm tossing game for two people sitting at a table. You lay a printed target on the table and take turns tossing a soft bean bag, or a rolled-up sock, so that it lands on the rings. Each of you keeps a tally by ticking boxes on paper, and you look at the ticks together when you stop. Nothing is timed, nothing is added up on screen, and nothing is saved or sent. Please read the safety notes first: small fillings are a choking hazard.
howTo: Read the safety notes. Choose a bag with a sewn-shut cover, or roll up a clean sock.
Tap "Print the target and tally sheet" and lay the sheet flat on the table between you.
Sit comfortably, one on each side, and take turns with one gentle toss each. Anyone may pass.
When a toss lands in a ring, tick a box in your column, on the row for that ring.
Look at the ticks together when you stop, or tap Rest to pause.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "That was a soft one." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: Cha nel clock, score, cunntey ny gaisht no cailleil. Gow ayns ec ny-yeih dy jeeaghyn, as stoppal dy-mooie ny y hallooin ta dy-chooilley feer vie dy chrieeagh.

faq.q: Is it safe to toss a bean bag?
faq.a: Gow dy-vel shoh, cha nel shen as sheeney. Cur-my-ner baag ta shoh rosht-dy-gerraghyn, ny sock ta roolit-erash, gyn dy jiu dy-mie bioan, reesh ny bioan beg, ta cheeaght dy ghoughtyn er son clooinaghyn beaggey as son dy-chooilley ta cur rudyn ayns e veeal. Fuirr ry-hoie, tilg er-yn-oyr dy dooinney dy ny-ymmyrkey, as cha jean goll dy ghoughtyn er aghtyn, as ver paant ayns eh-cheu.

faq.q: Is anything counted or saved on the screen?
faq.a: Cha nel. Ta'n cunntey ec y pheeyr, ayns boxyn ta uss jeet jeh mooar hene. Cha jean ny duillag cunntey na clock, as cha vow shen ny cur reayrt.

faq.q: What if someone cannot toss, or the bag lands off the sheet?
faq.a: Lhig da dooinney ny-yeih dy skeaddal, as baag ta cur er-lheh jeh y duillag bee er dy hoie er son y chied ynnyd. Cha vow shen cunntey.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: Un duillag: ny-mooar cheel ny-mooarey, goll ayns e three cronnaghyn ta ainmyn Near, Middle as Far, ny bwoallagh ayns shen ny colloonyn ec dooinney, as ny reamyn beggyn-kerree dy ticketyn er son kiaull reaghyn, as ynnyd jeh seihll sauchys. Ta ainmyn screeuit er y cronnaghyn, shen mish y gobbal ry-hooyr ayns geay as gorrym.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Ta, cha vow shen er-lhieu, as cha nel kiarn, cur-my-ner ny shassoo rish. Ta eh obbraghey ayns y ghleashaghey lesh tree, tablet ny computer.

seasonal-pack.name: Seasonal puzzle pack
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Printable Paper Puzzles
seasonal-pack.h1: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Three Paper Puzzles for Each Season
seasonal-pack.description: Three small printable puzzles for spring, summer, autumn or winter: match the pairs, circle the one that is different, and color a picture in. Choose a season, or take a rest day. Free to print.
seasonal-pack.short: Three printable puzzles for the season you choose, or a rest day.
seasonal-pack.players: All ages, solo or side by side
seasonal-pack.intro: Choose a season, and the page shows three small paper puzzles drawn from that season's pictures: two rows to join with lines, a row of four to circle the one that is different, and a picture to color in. You print one page, then do one, two or all three, at your own pace. Choose "Today is a rest day" instead and there is nothing to do.
howTo: Choose a season, or choose "Today is a rest day".
Look at the three puzzles, then tap "Print this season's pack".
Do one, two or all three, at your own pace.
Join the matching pictures with a line, circle the one that is different, and color the large picture in.
Stop whenever you like. A rest day is a good day too.
tips: Start with the puzzle that feels easiest today. One is enough.
Say the name of each picture aloud, if that helps.
Use crayons or pencils. Any colors are fine.
Keep the page for next time, or let it go.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clock, score, cunntey ny gaisht no cailleil. Gow ayns ec ny-yeih dy jeeaghyn, as stoppal dy-mooie ny y hallooin ta dy-chooilley feer vie dy chrieeagh.

faq.q: Does the page know which season it is?
faq.a: Cha nel. Ta uss jeet jeh'n ynnyd. Cha jean'n duillag syn er y ghrian na er dty ynnyd.

faq.q: Is there a score or a right answer?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha vow ny-yeih cunntey, goll er-cheu ny jeeaghyn ayns y gleashaghey, as cha vow freaghtyn ry-akin ny freayreyn. Ta pene jeh'n puzzle dy-mie ny jeeaghyn, cur er-lheh, cur cronney, ny loayn.

faq.q: What if nobody wants puzzles today?
faq.a: Gow "Ta'n laa shoh yn laa fuirraghey". Ta'n duillag er-yn-oyr dy yiarn kiaull ynnyd reamagh, as cha nel kiarn dy chur er-lheh na dy ghoughtyn.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: Un duillag son y season ta uss jeeaghyn: ny three puzzles, jeh-chooilley lesh yiarn beggey jeh sheshaght ny gobbal dy ghoughtyn, as yiarn dy ghra dy vel uss dy ghoughtyn un, daa ny ny three.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Ta, cha vow shen er-lhieu, as cha nel kiarn, cur-my-ner ny shassoo rish. Ta eh obbraghey ayns y ghleashaghey lesh tree, tablet ny computer.

decorate-a-card.name: Decorate a card together
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Decorate a Card Together: a Printable Greeting Card
decorate-a-card.h1: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. Choose an occasion, such as a birthday or a thank you, and decorate the front around its words. Then write a message on the back, together or one person writing what the other says. Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. There is no right card, and nothing is timed, scored or sent.
howTo: Vælg en anledning, og tryk derefter på "Print kortet".
Fold arket på midten langs den stiplede linje, så forsiden vender udad.
Én person pynter forsiden, og den anden pynter bagsiden, eller I skiftes til at pynte den ene side.
Skriv en besked sammen. Den ene kan skrive, mens den anden siger ordene.
Stop, når du vil. Et enkelt kort er lige så godt som et detaljeret.
tips: Begynd med ordene på forsiden, og tilføj derefter blade, stjerner eller prikker rundt om dem, ét ad gangen.
Hvis en person helst ikke vil tegne, kan vedkommende i stedet vælge farverne eller skrive beskeden.
Sig, hvad du godt kan lide ved den andens streger, frem for om de er gode.
Gem kortet et sted, hvor det kan gives væk, eller lad det bare ligge på bordet foreløbig.

faq.q: Er der en timer eller en pointtælling?
faq.a: Nej. Der er ingen ur, pointtælling, trækstæller eller nederlag. Du kan stoppe når som helst, og at stoppe halvvejs er en fuldt ud god måde at afslutte på.

faq.q: Skal vi bruge lim, saks eller klistermærker?
faq.a: Nej. Farvekridt, farveblyanter eller tusser er nok. Intet skal klippes, limes eller klistres.

faq.q: Kan vi lave et kort til en anledning, der ikke står på listen?
faq.a: Vælg "Bare fordi" og skriv dine egne ord på forsiden, eller pynt kortet uden nogen anledning.

faq.q: Bliver noget talt, bedømt eller gemt på skærmen?
faq.a: Nej. Siden viser kun kortet og trinene. Intet bliver rangeret, pointsat eller gemt, og der findes ikke et rigtigt kort.

faq.q: Hvad er på det udskrevne ark?
faq.a: Én side: et kort foldet på midten, med anledningsordene og en enkel ramme på forsiden, og linjer til en besked og en Fra-linje på bagsiden. Reglerne for to personer er trykt nederst.

faq.q: Er det gratis, og skal jeg oprette mig?
faq.a: Ja, det er gratis, og der kræves ingen konto, oprettelse eller download. Det virker i webbrowseren på telefon, tablet eller computer.

find-together.name: Find sammen
find-together.seoTitle: Find sammen: To personer finder parrene
find-together.h1: Find sammen: To personer, ét hold
find-together.description: To personer deler én skærm og skiftes til at vende to billedkort for at finde et par. Par findes sammen og tælles på én fælles optælling. Gratis at spille, uden timer eller pointtælling.
find-together.short: Skiftes til at finde billedparrene sammen med en person ved siden af.
find-together.intro: Kortene starter med billederne synlige, eller I kan lægge dem med forsiden nedad. På din tur vender du to kort. Er de et par, har I fundet det sammen, og turen går videre. Er de forskellige, bliver de liggende synlige, indtil du trykker på "Vend dem tilbage", så I begge kan se på dem. Du kan passe når som helst. Optællingen øverst går kun op: de par I har fundet sammen.
howTo: Vælg, hvor mange kort I vil bruge. Seks kort, tre par, er et roligt sted at starte.
Skærmen viser, hvis tur det er, med en cirkel for den første person og en firkant for den anden.
Vend to kort, det ene efter det andet. Passer de sammen, er parret fundet sammen.
Er de forskellige, trykker du på "Vend dem tilbage", når I begge er klar. Så går turen videre.
Hver af jer kan trykke på "Pas" når som helst. Tryk på "Start forfra" for nye kort, eller tryk på Hvil for at stoppe.
tips: Sid side om side, og sig billedernes navne højt sammen: "En tekop. Tager du mælk i din te?"
Lad den person, du passer på, trykke selv, også selv om det tager tid. Peg i stedet for at trykke for vedkommende.
Vælg "Kort med forsiden nedad", hvis I begge kan lide at vende kort for at finde billederne.

photo-pairs.description: Chymmlidys ny caslyssyn-soilshey lught-thie eu hene gys cloie co-reggyrtys meein. Reih 2 gys 6 caslyssyn-soilshey er yn saase eu; t'ad tannaghtyn 'sy vrowser eu as cha nel ad rieau laadit seose.
photo-pairs.short: Reih ny caslyssyn-soilshey eu hene as jean co-reggyrtys orroo. Cha nel nhee erbee laadit seose.
photo-pairs.intro: Roghnaigh dhá ghrianghraf go sé de do ghrianghrafanna teaghlaigh féin ó do ghuthán, do thablet nó do riarthóir, agus beidh siad mar chluiche meaitseála le pictiúir mhóra, infheicthe. Ní thaispeántar na grianghrafanna ach taobh istigh den leathanach seo. Ní uaslódáiltear, ní shábháiltear ná ní roinntear iad, agus imíonn siad nuair a dhúnann tú an leathanach. Más maith leat, cuir cúpla focal faoi gach grianghraf, agus is féidir le leid chineálta treo a thabhairt do phéire amháin tar éis sos. Is bealach é seo chun grianghrafanna teaghlaigh a fheiceáil le chéile.
howTo: Tapáil "Roghnaigh grianghrafanna" agus roghnaigh dhá ghrianghraf go sé.
Feictear gach grianghraf faoi dhó. Tapáil ceann amháin, ansin tapáil a phéire.
Más maith leat, cuir cúpla focal faoi gach grianghraf. Ní shábháiltear na ceannteidil.
Labhair faoi gach grianghraf agus tú ag aimsiú é.
Nuair a bheidh tú críochnaithe, dún an leathanach nó tapáil "Glan na grianghrafanna". Ní coinnítear rud ar bith.
tips: Reih caslyssyn-soilshey baghtal jeh reddyn maynrey, cadjin: peata, garey, boayl s'dooie, laa poosee.
Foddee dy vel jallooyn jeh buill as reddyn ny s'aashagh na eddynyn, as t'ad shaghney broo erbee dy enmys sleih.
Faag magh caslyssyn-soilshey jeh sleih ta marroo my foddee ad cur sneih doolaneagh, mannagh vel fys eu dy vel ad cur gerjagh.

faq.q: Vel ny caslyssyn-soilshey aym laadit seose boayl erbee?
faq.a: Cha nel. Ta'n duillag lhaih ny caslyssyn-soilshey ta shiu reih dy jeeragh 'sy vrowser eu as ta'n duillag taishbyney ad er y scaailan eu. Cha nel ad currit dooin ny da peiagh erbee elley, as t'ad ersooyl traa ta shiu dooney ny aalaadey yn duillag.

faq.q: Vel traa-reilleyder ny skoor ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skoor, coontaghey caghlaa-ynnyd ny cailltys erbee ayn. Foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee, as ta scuirr lieh-vollagh ny aght feer vie dy chur kione er.

faq.q: Noddym sauail y cloie da'n nah cheayrt?
faq.a: Cha nod 'sy vrowser, er currym, liorish shen cha nel nhee preevaadjagh erbee stoyrit. Foddee yn app nastee Creative Activities son iPhone as iPad freill coipyn jeh ny caslyssyn-soilshey reiht er yn saase eu.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo jallooyn
picture-bingo.description: Bingo pictiúr inphriontáilte saor in aisce do theaghlaigh, do ghrúpaí daoine aosta agus do thithe cúraim. Pictiúir mhóra le focail, 9 nó 16 cearnóg, agus glaoiteoir mór ar an scáileán.
picture-bingo.short: Kaartyn bingo jallooyn so-chlou as eamerey er scaailan mooar son possanyn.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo cadjin lesh jallooyn ayns ynnyd earrooyn, myr shen cha nel feme er peiagh erbee dy lhaih clou beg. Clou possan jeh kaartyn er-lheh, eisht jean ymmyd jeh'n eamerey er y scaailan dy haishbyney dagh jalloo dy mooar er çhellveeish, co-earrooder glioon ny claare-screeuee.
howTo: Reih 9 ny 16 kerrinyn er dagh kaart as cre cho mooar as ta'n earroo dy chloiederyn.
Crig er "Clou kaartyn". Ta dagh kaart anchasley.
Foshil yn eamerey er scaailan mooar. Crig er "Nah yalloo" dy haishbyney dagh jalloo marish e ennym.
Ta cloiederyn coodaghey yn jalloo co-reggyrtagh er y chaart oc lesh peesh-argid, cramman ny cowreyder.
Ta dagh fer ta lhieeney straih, ny yn kaart er-fey-ny-hoie, cosney ard-yindys. Cha nel caillee erbee 'sy lhieggan shoh: caghlaa cloie derrey ta linnagh ec dagh peiagh.
tips: Jean ymmyd jeh cowraghyn mooarey lheid as peeshyn dammey ny bayrnyn boteil. Foddee dy vel crammanyn beggey doillee dy hroggal.
Enmys y jalloo as loow red ennagh mychione: "Baatey-shiaull. Quoi t'er ve magh er baatey?"
Cur sleih ta doilleeid fakin oc ny s'faggys da'n scaailan, as jean piyryn jeh cooneydee marish cloiederyn ta feme oc orroo.
Ta nuy kerrinyn dy liooar son y chooid smoo jeh possanyn. Freill y çhymsaght mysh 20 gys 30 minnidyn.

faq.q: Kys ta mee stiurey bingo jallooyn ayns thie kiarail?
faq.a: Clou un chaart son dagh cloieder, cur yn eamerey er y scaailan smoo t'eu, as eam ny jallooyn dy moal, enmys dagh fer. Cloie derrey ta linnagh ec dagh peiagh, myr shen cha nel peiagh erbee faagit mooie.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee dy chlou?
faq.a: She. Clou whilleen kaartyn as ta feme eu orroo, cha mennick as sailliu, son ymmyd persoonagh ny possan.

faq.q: Nod sleih cloie gyn lhaih?
faq.a: She. Ta dagh kerrin ny yalloo mooar, marish e ennym fo son adsyn s'taitnys lioroo focklyn.

picnic-planner.name: Pleanálaí picnice
picnic-planner.seoTitle: Pleanálaí Picnice: Roghnaigh Pictiúir do Thuras Amach
picnic-planner.h1: Pleanálaí Picnice: Roghnaigh Pictiúir, Ansin Meaitseáil Iad
picnic-planner.description: Roghnaigh pictiúir bia agus rudaí le déanamh le haghaidh picnice, ansin imir cluiche meaitseála séimh leo. Níl am ar bith ann. Saor in aisce le himirt agus le priontáil.
picnic-planner.short: Roghnaigh pictiúir bia agus turais amach le haghaidh picnice, ansin meaitseáil iad.
picnic-planner.players: Duine amháin, nó 2 dhuine taobh le taobh
picnic-planner.intro: Tapáil pictiúir de bhia agus de rudaí le déanamh chun iad a chur i gciseán picnice, a fhaigheann suas le sé cinn. Insíonn abairt i bhfocail cad atá sa chiseán, mar shampla "Ár bpicnic: arán, cáis, úlla agus fleasc." Ansin tapáil "Imreoimid lenár bpicnic" le haghaidh babhta séimh meaitseála as na pictiúir roghnaithe. Fanann na pictiúir ar taispeáint, agus ní thomhaistear, ní scórálann agus ní shábháiltear rud ar bith. Priontálann "Priontáil ár liosta picnice" liosta seiceála de na rudaí a roghnaigh tú, le bosca seiceála do gach rud le pacáil.
howTo: Tapáil pictiúr de bhia nó de rud le déanamh. Téann sé isteach sa chiseán.
Tapáil pictiúr sa chiseán chun é a bhaint amach arís.
Roghnaigh dhá rud ar a laghad, ansin tapáil "Imreoimid lenár bpicnic".
Tapáil dhá phictiúr atá mar an gcéanna. Fanann na pictiúir ar taispeáint, mar sin ní gá aon rud a chuimhneamh.
Tapáil "Priontáil ár liosta picnice" le haghaidh liosta seiceála ar pháipéar le tabhairt leat.
tips: Fiafraigh de na daoine atá leat cad a bhfuil siad ag iarraidh a thabhairt, agus roghnaigh na pictiúir le chéile.
Labhair faoi gach pictiúr de réir mar a théann sé isteach: "An cuimhin leat an leadán a d'eitil muid ar an trá?"
Ar pháipéar, tá na línte bána le haghaidh aon rud eile ba mhaith leat a thabhairt, nó le hainm.

faq.q: An bhfuil amadóir, scór nó buaiteoir ann?
faq.a: Níl. Ní thomhaistear ná ní comhairtear rud ar bith, agus ní bhuann duine ar bith. Níl aon earráidí ná pointí sa bhabhta meaitseála.

faq.q: An plean béilí é seo?
faq.a: Níl. Is plean pictiúr le haghaidh turais amach é, le labhairt faoi agus le tabhairt leat ar pháipéar. Ní insíonn sé cad ba cheart do dhuine ar bith a ithe.

faq.q: An sábháiltear nó an seoltar na pictiúir a roghnaímid?
faq.a: Níl. Fanann an ciseán ar an leathanach seo amháin. Ní shábháiltear, ní uaslódáiltear ná ní sheoltar é, agus imíonn sé nuair a dhúnann tú an leathanach.

faq.q: An bhfuil leagan ar pháipéar ann?
faq.a: Tá. Priontálann "Priontáil ár liosta picnice" leathanach amháin, ar A4 nó US Letter. Taispeánann sé na pictiúir a roghnaigh tú, le bosca seiceála do gach ceann, agus línte bána do rud ar bith eile.

faq.q: An saor in aisce é, agus an gá clárú?
faq.a: Tá, is saor in aisce é, agus ní gá cuntas, clárú nó íoslódáil. Oibríonn sé i mbrabhsálaí gréasáin ar fhón, ar thablet nó ar ríomhaire.

scrapbook.name: Leabhar grianghraf
scrapbook.seoTitle: Leabhar Grianghraf: Iompaigh Grianghrafanna Teaghlaigh le Chéile, Leathanach ar Leathanach
scrapbook.h1: Leabhar Grianghraf: Cuir Do Ghrianghrafanna agus Ceannteidil Leat, Ansin Iompaigh na Leathanaigh
scrapbook.description: Roghnaigh dhá ghrianghraf go dhá cheann déag de do ghrianghrafanna teaghlaigh ar do ghléas agus iompaigh iad mar leabhar, le cúpla focal faoi gach ceann. Ní uaslódáiltear rud ar bith. Saor in aisce le priontáil.
scrapbook.short: Iompaigh leathanaigh do ghrianghrafanna teaghlaigh le chéile, mar leabhar.
scrapbook.players: Duine amháin, nó 2 dhuine taobh le taobh
scrapbook.intro: Roghnaigh dhá ghrianghraf go dhá cheann déag de do ghrianghrafanna ón ngléas seo. Bíonn grianghraf amháin ina leathanach de leabhar, sách mór le feiceáil, le focail roghnacha faoi. Iompaigh na leathanaigh leis na cnaipí nó na saighdiúir ar an méarchlár, agus úsáid "Féach le chéile" chun suí taobh le taobh leis na grianghrafanna agus na focail amháin. Fanann do ghrianghrafanna ar an ngléas seo. Ní uaslódáiltear nó ní shábháiltear iad, agus imíonn an leabhar nuair a dhúnann tú an leathanach. Priontálann "Priontáil an leabhar grianghraf" grianghraf amháin agus a fhocail ar gach leathanach, le huimhreacha leathanach.
howTo: Tapáil "Roghnaigh grianghrafanna" agus roghnaigh dhá ghrianghraf go dhá cheann déag. Iarr cead sula n-úsáideann tú grianghraf de dhuine nach féidir leis an gceist a fhreagairt le tá.
Iompaigh na leathanaigh le "Leathanach roimhe" agus "An chéad leathanach eile", nó leis na saighdiúir Clé agus Deas ar an méarchlár.
Cuir cúpla focal faoi ghrianghraf más maith leat. Úsáid "Bog níos luaithe" nó "Bog níos déanaí" chun an ord a athrú.
Tapáil "Féach le chéile" chun na rialuithe eagarthóireachta a cheilt agus féachaint ar an leabhar taobh le taobh.
Tapáil "Priontáil an leabhar grianghraf" le cóip pháipéir, nó "Glan an leabhar" nuair a bheidh tú críochnaithe. Ní coinnítear rud ar bith.
tips: Jean dealbhyn dy chiart as dy chooilleenagh: gharrey, cat, as y ynnyd t'ayd smoo er. Gow er ny chiart mychione pejeeagh duillag wheesh shiu eh chur y raad.
Lhiggey da y theihll ny fockle jeh pejeeagh duillag, ny fockle jeih haink, as scrih shen dy kiart ny ta ad gra eh.
Er paper, ta ny duillagyn clootit er nyn ghoyr ayns coonlaghyn, as ta'n theihll gobbyr dy chur dealbhyn as rinnyn ny-hene timmyltagh orroo.

faq.q: Ta ynnydagh, pointey ny buailteyr ayns?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha vel ynnydagh, pointey ny cooinaghtyn ayns, as cha vel nane buailt. Ta'n earroose duillag ry-ghoaldagh dy hayll shiu cre'n ynnyd ta shiu ayns y lioar.

faq.q: Ta ny dealbhyn ny focklyn nyn gheddyn, currit er ny chur magh ayns?
faq.a: Cha nel. Ta ny dealbhyn lhiassit son y duillag shoh eh-hene, cha vel ad currit, ny chooilleenit, ny cur gys nane. Ta ny focklyn fo'n dealbh ry-chooilley fo'n duillag ta shiu ayns eh. Pan vaghtyr y duillag, ta'n lioar er ny cur magh.

faq.q: Nee shin clootey yn lioar?
faq.a: Nee. “Clootey yn lioar” clooys dealbh as focklyn er cadlaa duillag, as earroosyn duillagyn ayns. Jean A4 ny US Letter ayns y cliaghtey clootey.

faq.q: Ta eh sauchit, as nee shiu cur cooinaghtyn ayns?
faq.a: Ta, ta eh sauchit, as cha vel cooinaghtyn, cur ayns, ny ghoaill ny lhiggey ass. Ta eh obbyr ayns y browsaghyn lioar er fon, tabbyl ny kiare-yn.

collage-board.name: Bord collage
collage-board.seoTitle: Bord Collage: Daa Dooinney Cur Dealbhyn ayns Coraa
collage-board.h1: Bord Collage: Cur Dealbhyn er Bord Jeih, ayns Coraa
collage-board.description: Daa dooinney ta suyr ry-chooilley ry-chooilley ayns coraa dy chur dealbhyn scrutit er bord lhiassagh jeih. Dooar scrutit, as oike ny pointey er ny ghoaill. Sauchit dy gheddyn as clootey.
collage-board.short: Cur dealbhyn er bord lhiassagh ayns coraa.
collage-board.intro: Ta daa dooinney suyr ry-chooilley ry-chooilley ry-hooar bord jeih ny 12 ynnydyn as coonlagh jeh 8 dealbhyn scrutit. Dooar scrutit, as ta dealbh ry-chooilley dy chur ayns ynnyd voish. Ta'n coraa nyn gheddyn ry-hooar y ghoaill. Ta cummal dealbhyn dooinney ny-hene nyn gheddyn cruinney ny chearnagh, as shen ta bord shiu ec ghoaill cre ta cur er ny ghoaill gyn fo'n dolan. Nee daa dooinney dy hoie, as nee ny ghoaill ny cur ny lhiggey ass ny cliaghtey dy chur er ny cooinaghtyn ayns dy eayrt ny ynnyd ny smoo. Cha vel ynnydagh, pointey ny cooinaghtyn ayns. “Clootey y bord” clooys y bord voish as ny dealbhyn dy scrutit.
howTo: Dooar scrutit ayns y coonlagh. Ta “Chosen” er scrih tra ta eh ghoaill.
Dooar ynnyd voish er y bord. Ta'n scrutit ayns shen, as ta'n coraa er ny ghoaill.
Nee daa dooinney dooar “Trooid” ayns cooinaghtyn, ny “Gow er ny ghoaill y scrutit dy-jerrey” dy chur er ny hon dy-kiart.
Dooar “Coonlagh dy dealbhyn elley” dy gheddyn coonlagh elley. Ta dealbhyn ta er y bord cur fo ec ny ynnydyn jeh.
Dooar “Tosh ass-noa” dy hauail y bord, as “Cur ersooyl eh” tra ta shiu cur er yn choraa.
tips: Gra ennym dy chooilley dealbh tra ta eh rish y bord, lesh shen mychione “y cupp te ry-chiart y thie”. Ta gra ny cooinaghtyn ny ynnyd oor ny ghoaill.
Lhiggey da daa dooinney dy ghoaill scrutit y dealbh as ynnyd, dy beagh cummal ec y chooilley-ghoaill ayns.
Er paper, gow er ny 8 dealbhyn lesh cooney jeh dooinney as cur ad er ny cuinnaghyn clootit.

faq.q: Ta ynnydagh, pointey ny buailteyr ayns?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha vel ynnydagh, pointey ny cooinaghtyn ayns, as cha vel nane buailt. Bord lhean ta bord ta cur dealbh ry-chooilley ynnyd.

faq.q: Ta ny dealbhyn ta shiu cur er nyn gheddyn ny cur gys nane?
faq.a: Cha nel. Ta'n bord er y duillag shoh eh-hene. Cha vel eh sauchit, cur ayns, ny cooinaghtyn, as ta eh ayns cur magh tra ta shiu gerrey y duillag.

faq.q: Cre'n fa ta shiu gra cre dealbh ta dy cheer ry-hooar?
faq.a: Ta cummal jeh dooinney ny-hene. Ta cruinney ayns coonlagh dealbhyn y chied dooinney, as chearnagh ayns coonlagh dealbhyn yn nhaaghyrt dooinney, as ta ennym dy chooilley dooinney er son y bord.

faq.q: Ta lhiassagh paper ayn?
faq.a: Ta. “Clootey y bord” clooys y bord voish dy 12 cuinnaghyn, lesh 8 dealbhyn fo ad ry-hooar er y meeyr chiaralagh, as y loayrt gearradh. Ta cooney jeh aanee dy gearradh.

faq.q: Ta eh sauchit, as nee shiu cur cooinaghtyn ayns?
faq.a: Ta, ta eh sauchit, as cha vel cooinaghtyn, cur ayns, ny ghoaill ny lhiggey ass. Ta eh obbyr ayns y browsaghyn lioar er fon, tabbyl ny kiare-yn.

garden-planner.name: Planner gharrey
garden-planner.seoTitle: Planner Gharrey: Cur Plannaght jeh Gharrey lesh Dealbhyn Lusanyn
garden-planner.h1: Planner Gharrey: Dooar Dealbhyn as Cur Plannaght er Gharrey
garden-planner.description: Dooar dealbhyn lusanyn as nhyn gharrey, as cur ad ayns 12 cuinnaghyn jeh plannaght. Dooar dealbh, as ynnyd voish. Cha vel ynnydagh na pointey. Sauchit dy gheddyn as clootey.
garden-planner.short: Dooar dealbhyn lusanyn as cur plannaght jeh 12 cuinnaghyn.
garden-planner.intro: Dooar dealbhyn veih coonlagh lusanyn as nhyn gharrey, as dooar ynnyd dy chur dy chooilley dealbh ayns e chooilleenagh. Ta plannaght ayns 12 cuinnaghyn, as ta cuinnaght ry-chooilley dealbh ayns. Ta coontey ayns focklyn, ta gra “Ta da plannaght shiu 3 gaarnaghyn, 2 raasagh as 1 billey.” Cha vel ynnydagh, pointey ny cooinaghtyn ayns, as cha vel coraa ayns. Ta shoh plannaght dealbhyn dy ghra mychione, cha nel cooney jeh cur lusanyn. “Clootey y plannaght” clooys y cuinnaghyn lesh y dealbhyn ta shiu dooar, lesh cuinnaghyn baase dy scrih ayns as lhiassyn dy screeu nodyn.
howTo: Dooar dealbh ayns y coonlagh. Ta “Chosen” er scrih tra ta eh ghoaill.
Dooar cuinnagh. Ta'n dealbh ayns shen, as ta'n dooar er ny cur sheese.
Dy hoi cuinnagh, dooar dealbh elley as dooar y cuinnagh. Dy scrah cuinnagh, dooar eh gyn dealbh ghoaill.
Dooar “Tosh ass-noa” dy scrah dy chooilley cuinnagh, as “Cur ersooyl eh” tra ta shiu cur er yn choraa.
Dooar “Clootey y plannaght” son lhiassyn paper jeh'n plannaght as y coontey.
tips: Di'n dagh picture wish goll stroie, abbyrr ad mychione: "y blaa goll ry-hoill y thie-eoin". Ta'n çhaggal yn cur da'n ynsaghey dy chooilley lhiasaghey.
Lhig da dagh unnane pickey picture dy ghoaldee, ny cur pickyn ayns yn ynsaghey, dy liooar dagh unnane goll ayns y çheayll.
Ayns y pabyr, ta'n lossanyn bane son dy scrïvey dy ard-sheelyn nyn ynnyd, as ta'n lhiggyn nottiagh son rud dy vel shin eisht cur dy chur ayns cooishyn.

faq.q: Vel shoh çhamanyn çhyn?
faq.a: Cha vel. Ta shoh çhaghyr picture dy ghoaldee mychione, cha nel çhamanyn çhyn. Cha jean eh innse cre'n traa, cre'n ynnyd ny cre'n dooie dy chur rud dy hen, rish dy vel shoh er son ny hauv ayd.

faq.q: Vel çhaslaght, scoar ny buggane ayns shoh?
faq.a: Cha vel. Cha vel rud çhaslaght, scoartit, reayrit ny cheeaght, as cha vel neb dy ghra. Cha vel ny lane wheesh jeh dy chur-moo son lane ynnyd.

faq.q: Vow ny picturyn ta shin goaldee er nyn sauail ny ta ad ruggit magh?
faq.a: Cha vow. Ta'n plan er y hoght ayns yn duillag shoh cheu. Cha vow eh sauailt, ta ad cur magh ny cheeaght, as ta eh gaase ayns shimmey yn duillag toshiaght.

faq.q: Vel ver-pabyr jeh?
faq.a: Vel. "Cur y plan magh" cur yn plan magh ayns un duillag, er A4 ny US Letter. Ta eh y chur magh ny dwy-çheead goll, lesh y picturyn ta shin er nyn gooyl, y chooilleenyn ayns briatrey, as lhiggyn bane son nottyn.

faq.q: Vel eh sauail, as nee oo shiaralagh?
faq.a: Vel, ta eh sauail, as cha nee oo cosney na shiaralagh na downloadey. Ta eh obbyr ayns y çhiaghyn-earree ayns telefon, tabley ny computer.

coloring-wall.name: Balley dathey cooinaght
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Balley Dathey Cooinaght: Un Picture Son Ynnyd Mooarey
coloring-wall.h1: Balley Dathey Cooinaght: Un Picture Mooar, Dathit Cooinaght
coloring-wall.description: Cur picture mooar magh er dy liooar duillagyn, dy hooar un theihll, class ny thie-foshley dathey un balley cooinaght. Sauail dy chur magh. Cha vel çhaghyr, ny çhaslaght ny scoar.
coloring-wall.short: Cur un picture mooar magh er duillagyn son dy liooar dagh dathey.
coloring-wall.intro: Cooilleeney picture jeh'n duillagyn dathey as balley jeh 4, 6 ny 9 duillagyn. Cur y balley magh: ta'n duillag toshiaght gra kyndagh dy chur eh cooinaght, as ta pob duillag elley yn un chooid jeh'n picture mooar cheddin, lesh label dy ghoaldee ayns y chooinaght, da-yn A1. Ta pob unnane dathey un duillag ny dy liooar, ayns dathyn ny dooghyn ny-cheddin. Ta'n duillagyn eisht çhoorit tra label, as cheangit lesh ribbin ayns eddyr. Cha vel rud çhaghyrit, scoartit ny sauailt.
howTo: Cooilleeney picture, as eisht cooilleeney kiart duillagyn ta'n balley goll er.
Lhig da'n map ayns y scrin, ta sheeyley cre'n ynnyd ta pob label goll.
Ym "Cur y balley magh", as cur dy chooilley duillag magh.
Cur un duillag ny dy liooar da pob unnane dy dathey. Cha vel feme dy gheddyn dathyn ny dooghyn cheddin.
Cur y duillagyn ayns çhoorey ny labelyn, as cheangil ad lesh ribbin ayns eddyr.
tips: Cur y duillagyn ny sostey dy ard-chooilley da ny follaghyn ta yiow fardail sheeaght, as ny kiart ny lheeannagh da ny follaghyn ta lhiggey orroo.
Crog y balley ayns ynnyd ta cur lesh dagh unnane er ny geddyn, as jean kaslagh ny chooilleenyn er y chooid.
Cooilleeney balley bieyr son bwrd beg, as un mooar son ronn.

faq.q: Vel çhaslaght, scoar ny buggane ayns shoh?
faq.a: Cha vel. Cha vel rud çhaslaght, scoartit ny reayrit, as cha vel neb dy ghra. Ta'n balley jeant er son picture dathit lesh follaghyn lhoo.

faq.q: Vow ny duillagyn er nyn sauail ny ta ad ruggit magh?
faq.a: Cha vow. Ta'n balley jeant ayns y hoght shoh cheu. Cha vow eh sauailt, ta eh ruggit magh ny reayrit, as ta eh gaase tra ta oo dooie y hoght.

faq.q: Feum y dathyn dy chooilleeney?
faq.a: Cha feum. Gheddyn pob unnane dathyn ny dooghyn ny-cheddin. Ta'n duillagyn ayns shen goll ayns un picture.

faq.q: Vel ver-pabyr jeh?
faq.a: Vel. Ta'n balley clowit ny cur magh ammey yn cuspey ayns eh: duillag toshiaght lesh y chooilleenyn as map, as un duillag son dagh chooid jeh'n picture.

faq.q: Vel eh sauail, as nee oo shiaralagh?
faq.a: Vel, ta eh sauail, as cha nee oo cosney na shiaralagh na downloadey. Ta eh obbyr ayns y çhiaghyn-earree ayns telefon, tabley ny computer.

quiet-shapes.name: Puzzle sheeaght shiaull
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Puzzle Sheeaght Shiaull: Cur Sheeaghyn ayns Picture
quiet-shapes.h1: Puzzle Sheeaght Shiaull: Cur y Chooilleenyn ayns y Picture
quiet-shapes.description: Cur sheeaghyn simple ayns ynnyd jeh thie, bad, iasc as ny smoo. Cur dagh ro-hoill, eisht ynnyd dy sheeagh cheddin. Cha vel çhaghyr ny scoar. Sauail dy ghoaldee as dy chur magh.
quiet-shapes.short: Cur sheeaghyn simple ayns picture, ry-ghoaldee.
quiet-shapes.intro: Ta ynnyd picture, dy liooar mish thie, bad ny rocket, rennit ayns ynnyd. Ta ynnyd jeh dagh un ghiare cheddin, triangle mooar ny beg, cearnag, paralellogram ny rectangle. Cur dagh ro-hoill, eisht cur ynnyd sheeagh cheddin, as ta eh cheddin. Ta'n ynnyd cur'n ghiare er son oo, cha vel feme dy chur ny dy yiarn. Mannagh vel ghiare sheeagh elley na ynnyd, ta eh goll ayns y dorn lesh nota beg. Cha vel rud çhaghyrit ny scoartit, as cha vel rud er nyn sauail ny ta ad ruggit magh. "Cur y sheeagh shoh magh" cur yn ynnyd as ny ghiareyn ayns un duillag son dathey ny geyre.
howTo: Cur dagh ro-hoill ayns y dorn. Ta eh gra "Cooilleenit" tra ta eh cooilleenit.
Cur dagh ynnyd ayns y picture. Mannagh vel sheeagh cheddin, ta'n giare goll ayns shen.
Mannagh vel eh cheddin, feiy ynnyd elley. Cha vel rud er gholl gys feiyr ynnyd.
Cur dagh giare ayns y picture dy gheddyn ayns y dorn, ny cur "Toshiaght nagh jeh" dy gheddyn ad ooilley ayns y dorn.
Tra vel dagh ynnyd lesh e ghiare, ta'n picture crooit. Cur "Sheeagh elley" son un noa, ny cur Roish dy shtoo.
tips: Cur ny lineyn-cliaghtyn er dy akin yn ynrick nyn ynrickyn. Cur ad dy hoi son ny lhiannyn, dy vel shen lheih cur rish gaisht, as yn oyr ynrick hene ry-akin.
Tosh ny cruinneyn mooar, ny aarn as ny aarnyn-eshyn. Ta ny cruinneyn beggey ny chennaghyn ec y chrouin.
Ghoit ny cruinneyn ayns y chooyl ass y lhiassagh: "traingle, quadrail, aarn fada". Ta ynnydys ayns yn chleaysh ny ghoan ry-ghoan er.
Er pape, dath ny cruinneyn lesh 2 ny 3 dathyn, ny lhie ad dy chur ad bunnane lesh cooney ny ghoaill ny aase.

faq.q: Ta tamlagh, cooid-reayrt ny cooid-gluiney ayns?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha vel rud tamlit, reamit ny reayrt. Cha vel cruinney nagh vel dy chur er ny cur er gyn fa, as nee oo stop ec y chooilley traa.

faq.q: Ta rud erbee ta nyn cur er sauchey ny cur gys ayns?
faq.a: Cha nel. Ta'n dealg ayns y hoght shoh-ny-halloo. Cha vel eh sauchit, cur gys ny reamit, as cha vel eh cur er cooie. Nee eh gone paagh ny jig yn skeayl.

faq.q: Vel ny lioaryn ayns mooar son crione-chur ny screen beg?
faq.a: Ta'n ynrick mooarit rish y mooarys ta ny screen dy chiart, as y chooilley cruinney button ta ny lhieu ec yn eaddagh ny yn eaddagh Tab. Ta ny cruinneyn ayns yn tray ny buttonyn mooarey yn dealg.

faq.q: Ta fer ayns pape?
faq.a: Ta. Cur "Print this shape" ny dealg un dealg er un duillag: ny lineyn as ny lhiannyn-cliaghtyn, as ny cruinneyn cur er yn mooarys cheddin ry-henn. Dath ny cruinneyn, ny lhie ad dy chur ad bunnane. Lhig da ny cadjeyn yn obbyr ny gaagagh.

faq.q: Ta eh ennagh, as nee oo jeet ayns ny cur er ayns?
faq.a: Ta, ta eh ennagh, as cha vel cooid, cur ayns ny ghoo ny ghoo-gaaisht. Ta eh obbyr ayns y browseyr web ec telefon, tablet ny computer.

calm-breathing.name: Ennalaghey kiune
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Shiaght Analaghtey Anail dy Roie Ghoan
calm-breathing.description: Fastee ennalagh moal, kiune dy rheynn: ta kiarkyl meein gaase as leodaghey son shey tayrtyn ennal. Ta shiu goaill toshiaght er, as foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee.
calm-breathing.short: Kiarkyl moal dy ghoaill ennal marish. Gow toshiaght as scuirr traa sailliu.
calm-breathing.intro: Ny keayrtyn she fastee kiune yn obbyr share. Crig er "Gow toshiaght", eisht tayrn stiagh nyn n-ennal traa ta'n kiarkyl gaase as lhig magh nyn n-ennal traa t'eh leodaghey. Reih bieauid ny s'melley ny ny s'tappee. Cha nel eh ny lheeys, agh traa sheeoil dy rheynn.
howTo: Soie dy soccaragh lhiattee ry lhiattee.
Reih bieauid: moal ny meein.
Crig er "Gow toshiaght". Tayrn stiagh nyn n-ennal traa ta'n kiarkyl gaase, as lhig magh nyn n-ennal traa t'eh leodaghey.
T'eh scuirr liorish hene lurg shey tayrtyn ennal, ny crig er "Scuirr" traa erbee sailliu.
tips: Glack laueyn ny cur laue er roih yn dooinney my vel shen so-oltallagh.
Ny jean eginaghey rieau. My sailliu ny smoo fakin, ta shen mie dy liooar.
My ta doilleeidyn ennal ec peiagh erbee, gow ennal dy cadjin as jeeagh er y chiarkyl ynrican. Loow rish fer-lhee mychione imnea ennal erbee.

faq.q: Vel shoh cliaghtey ennalagh lheeysagh?
faq.a: Cha nel. She fastee aashagh, reihyssagh t'ayn son kiuney as sheshaght. Cha nel eh ny lheeys son imnea ny stayd erbee. Loow rish fer-lhee mychione imneaghyn slaynt.

faq.q: Vel y kiarkyl gleashaghey gyn mee dy ghoaill toshiaght er?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel veg gleashaghey derrey nee oo broo er Toshiaght, as t'eh scuirr lurg shey ennalyn ny tra nee oo broo er Scuirr. My ta dty ghreie soiit dy leodaghey gleashaght, ta ny focklyn caghlaa gyn y kiarkyl gaase.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er recortey?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, recortys, ny laadey neose erbee ayn. T'eh gobbraghey ayns y ronseyder eddyr-voggyl er çhellvane, tablet ny co-earrooder.

story-chain.name: Cadjin y skeayl
story-chain.seoTitle: Cadjin y Skeayl: Cluich Skeayl Ny Dealgyn Coayrt
story-chain.h1: Cadjin y Skeayl: Inse skeayl, un dealg ec yn traa
story-chain.description: Ta lhiassagh dealgyn ny vea jeh shiaght ry-henn, as dy chooilley jeh dy skeeal ny dooinney gyn sheeney dy chur er. Cha vel rud ny screeu, cha vel freayll ree mie. Ghoan, gyn clock as gyn cooid-reayrt.
story-chain.short: Cur dealg er-lheh, as skeeal dy chooilley jeh, dy chooilley ny cur.
story-chain.intro: Ta'n cluich toshee lesh un dealg as jean lhiassagh ny cadjin un dealg er-lheh. Dy chooilley jeh, dooinney, ta skeeal ayns y chloie er y chadjin ny ta er ny chur, dy aile. Ta skeeal shen fo ny cur ayns y chooilley ynrick, as ta eh ny skeeal beg ny bree. Cha vel rud screeuit, cha vel reamit ny sauchit, cha vel freayll ree mie, as ta cead ny ghoaill ry-hanney. Ta'n cadjin stoit er 8 dealgyn, as nee oo jannoo cadjin noa.
howTo: Jeeaghyn y chied dealg ayns cooney.
Gyn ny ghoaill: dy chooilley jeh, dooinney, ta skeeal er y chadjin ny ta er ny chur. Ta cead ny ghoaill ry-hanney.
Shiaght "Cur dealg er-lheh" dy chur yn dealg ny chionn ayns y chadjin.
Shiaght "Gow y dealg jiu" my vel oo ry-ghoan dy chur gys un dealg dy chooilley.
Ta 8 dealgyn ayns y chadjin, shiaght "Toshee cadjin noa" dy chadjin noa, ny stop er-lheh.
tips: Shoh dy chooilley: "Ta fer er gow ny pooar ec y coodagh." Ta'n jeh elley ry-heet dy chur ayns cheer, ny ny ghoaill.
Lhig da ny dealgyn ny stiurey. Cha vel skeeal ry-akin ta ny ta oo lhiggey dy ghoaill.
Stop cur yn traa nagh vel oo ec yn ard. Stop ayns y lhaa ta bey dy-cooilleen da ny cadjin.

faq.q: Ta tamlagh ny cooid-reayrt ayns?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha vel clock, cooid-reayrt, cooid-gluiney ny cur-er. Nee oo stop ec y chooilley traa, as stop ayns y lhaa ta bey dy-cooilleen da ny cadjin.

faq.q: Ta skeeal screeuit ny clagt ayns?
faq.a: Cha nel. Ta'n skeeal ry-ghoan, as cha vel ad screeuit, clagt ny cur gys erbee. Ta'n cluich ny sheeaghtyn ny dealgyn ynrick.

faq.q: Shen as nagh vel dooinney ny chur rud erbee?
faq.a: Cead ny ghoaill ry-hanney, as ta'n jeh elley ry-heet goll ayns. Cha vel fer er ny ghoaill dealg, ny cooinaghtyn un ynrick.

faq.q: Ta eh ennagh, as nee shin cur ayns ny cur er?
faq.a: Ta, ta eh ennagh, as cha vel cooid, cur ayns, ny ghoo ny ghoo-gaaisht. Ta eh obbyr ayns y browseyr web ec telefon, tablet ny computer.

quiet-scene.name: Sheeaghtyn ghoan
quiet-scene.seoTitle: Sheeaghtyn Ghoan: Un Dealg Ec Yn Chooilley Traa
quiet-scene.h1: Sheeaghtyn Ghoan: Un Dealg Ghoan Ec Yn Chooilley Traa
quiet-scene.description: Un dealg mooar, ghoan, ec yn chooilley traa, as yn chooilley un ec un lhiassagh ghoan fo. Coyrt Chiare ny Er-lheh my vel oo ry-ghoan. Cha vel rud ny cluich ayns y lhaa, cha vel traa ny cooid-reayrt. Cluich ta saor, gyn cheerey.
quiet-scene.short: Jean sheeaghtyn ghoan ec yn chooilley traa, ec dty lheid fein.
quiet-scene.players: Ec dty lheid, ny buinn ayns yn chooilley ynrick
quiet-scene.intro: Ta un dealg mooar lane yn screen, as un lhiassagh ghoan fo. Coyrt "Dealg er-lheh" ny "Dealg roish" my vel oo ry-ghoan dy chur dealg elley. Cha vel rud cur er, goll ny cooid-reayrt ec y chooilley. Coyrt "Dealg mooar" dy jeeaghyn yn dealg hene, dy vel y buinn kiart ny jeeaghyn ec y telly.
howTo: Jeeaghyn y dealg rish.
Lhig lhiassagh y dealg ass as fo, mannagh vel oo ry-ghoan.
Shiaght "Dealg er-lheh" ny "Dealg roish" my vel oo ry-ghoan.
Shiaght "Dealg mooar" dy jeeaghyn yn dealg hene, as "Lhig dy chur ny cooishyn" dy chur ny stiagh arree.
Stop ec y chooilley traa lesh "Dy-cooilleen son nane".
tips: Lhig da'n dooinney cur-ny-skeayl jeh: nee ad jeeaghyn, as nee oo shiaght "Dealg er-lheh".
Son cheshaght, shiaght "Dealg mooar" er telly ny screen mooar, as cuir ayns y chooilley ren jeeaghyn eh.
Cha vel fer nane dy yerrey dealg. Cha vel cooie ayns skeeal er dy chur as jeeaghyn ec dealg ta cheet ny sheeaghtyn.

faq.q: Ta tamlagh ny cooid-reayrt ayns?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha vel clock, cooid-reayrt, cooid-gluiney ny cur-er. Nee oo stop ec y chooilley traa, as stop ayns y lhaa ta bey dy-cooilleen da ny cadjin.

faq.q: Ta fuaim ny cur ayns?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha vel fuaim, as cha vel rud ny cur ny ghoaill er y hoght hene. Ta dealg ny cur-er ayns y chooilley shiaght ny button.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Cha nel. Ta eh dy hannaghtyn da yn dooinney jeet dy harrish er sheshaght, ny scrien. Ta ymmydey dy laghyn currit ny cartey post erbee hooar ayns y vlaaghey ec y shaaght çheu er yn un chooyl.

faq.q: Ta eh sauchey, as va mee ecsaa dy chlaaaghtyn?
faq.a: Ta, ta eh sauchey, as cha nel ny cuntas, ny claaghtyn, ny jiu erbee. Ta eh obbraghey ayns y browser ayns fo-lhaim, tabletyn ny computer.

color-wash.name: Nieu lowe
color-wash.seoTitle: Nieu Lowe: Dathyn Boggey Trooid Duillag
color-wash.h1: Nieu Lowe: Dathyn Boggey Paent Trooid Duillag
color-wash.description: Ta breesh boggey peintey lowaghyn lheun, dooyrt, dathyn trooid duillag jeh un chooyl, ayns kiare dathyn as daa ghooghyn breesh. Cha nel ennagh chrooit, cha nel scoarey ny tiaddey. Sauchey dy chlaaaghtyn, cha vel cuntas feum.
color-wash.short: Peint lowaghyn boggey dathyn trooid duillag, er dty hoi feiyn.
color-wash.players: Ayns y chooyl, ny daa ny lesh er y gheay
color-wash.intro: Un duillag as un breesh boggey. Gow dathyn as ghooghey breesh, as fakin trooid y duillag dy chur lowaght dathyn er. Cha nel ennagh chrooit ayns y duillag: cha nel rud dy chrooit, cha nel dealbh dy ghoaill rish ny scoarey. Cur er jees lowaghyn ny feeyst, ny cur y breesh sy traa as jean ny bregh. Duillag noa ghoaill dy hoillee shaghyn, as Cur er jeh dy hoi thie ad.
howTo: Gow dathyn. Ta ennym screeuit ry-akin da pob dathyn.
Gow Lheun ny Lheun fer. Ta Lheun fer ny sherbee duillag liorish pob shoh.
Fakin trooid y duillag liorish dorn, luch ny pen dy chur lowaght dathyn er.
Ny cur er yn grooagyn sleih dy hoi y fainey dy chooilleeney breesh, as Space dy chur y breesh sy traa ny dy hoi sheese.
Crio "Duillag noa" dy ghlaaghey y duillag, eisht "Cur er jeh dy hoi thie ad" my vees ayd feer lowaghyn y hoi.
tips: Lhig da'n dooinney elley dathyn y lowaght nish dy chur er, as screeu mychione y dathyn jeh ad ta goll er.
Ta Lheun fer nish ny share da laue screeaght, er-y-fa nagh vel feme dy ve cur er y breesh cur er yn cheer ceart.
Cha nel ennagh cheayll ceart dy peintey. Stop cha jeeaght ayd, ny crio "Ta mee jeant son nish".

faq.q: Vel crooin, scoarey ny tiaddey ayns?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha vel crooin ayns y duillag. Cha vel rud crooit, cur er scoarey, tiaddey ny scoarit, as cha jean ennagh screeu dy yeeaghey ort dy chur lhied erbee veih.

faq.q: Vel y duillag sauchit ny cur er enmys?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha vel rud sauchit, clo ny cur er enmys nane. Ta'n lowaghyn trooid y duillag tra t'oo fo'n duillag shen.

faq.q: Foddee oo shassoo heb luch ny scrien ynsee?
faq.a: Foddee. Tra ta'n duillag ayns fockle, ta'n raaghyn ynsee yn gheay breesh, as ta eeyl Space yn breesh cur er ny dy hoi sheese. Ta'n scrien gra "Breesh er" ny "Breesh sheese" pob traa.

faq.q: Vel reayrt ec paaroo?
faq.a: Cha nel. Ta watercolor ec paaroo y shen currit: breesh fliugh as un dathyn ec un traa, agh ta shoh çhenn ghoaill eh dy chooilleeney ayns y vaarle.

faq.q: Ry-akin vel ad?
faq.a: Buigh, orange, glass as purpyl, ny kiare dathyn cheddin ayns ny ghurrey dealbhyn elley ain. Ta ennym screeuit ry-akin da pob dathyn, as ta'n ennym çhengey ry-heose ny sherbee.

faq.q: Ta eh sauchey, as va mee ecsaa dy chlaaaghtyn?
faq.a: Ta, ta eh sauchey, as cha nel ny cuntas, ny claaghtyn, ny jiu erbee. Ta eh obbraghey ayns y browser ayns fo-lhaim, tabletyn ny computer.
